polityNote: Kingdom of Norway (mainland; Svalbard and Jan Mayen are outside the fylker and outside these atoms). First level = fylker: 19 from 1972-01-01 (Bergen joined Hordaland) to 2017, 18 from 2018-01-01 (Trøndelag). Each fylke is the union of the geoBoundaries NOR ADM2 kommuner whose KLASS 2013 number carries its fylke number (same-name pairs Bø, Herøy, Nes, Os, Sande, Våler decided by the atom's position; Sámi-named atoms matched to their kommune numbers). The atom set's manifest year is 2013 but its Vestfold carries the 2017 Sandefjord merger; SSB lists no inter-fylke change between 2002 and 2017 other than whole-kommune moves, so either vintage gives the same fylke lines. SSB notes its record of boundary adjustments in uninhabited areas may be incomplete before 1996.
